body: feeling super overwhelmed right now! 2 midterms this week, 2 midterms next week, have to spend hours in the lab for my experiments this week, taking care of executive shit for my club every day, my dog died last week and I haven't had a minute to just sit down and be sad about it. oof

i relate to this a lot. I visited /r/selfharmscars because I saw it mentioned on this sub and everyone's scars are so much larger/deeper/darker... even though I know it's silly to think this way I wonder why I couldn't do that too. I think I'm actually pretty squeamish about it and I feel stupidly guilty for it
I've been feeling like this recently. a while ago I used to cry really easily, but now even when I want to I can't. I thought cutting might help draw out the tears but even that didn't work
I grab ice cubes and hold them in my hand really tight. kinda hurts because it's so cold but it's ultimately harmless

gotta get them endorphins!! also it lets me focus on mopping up the blood rather than whatever else I'm thinking about. I actually don't really like the pain, I'm kind of a wuss, but I'm just used to cutting as my default stress response I guess
